info.title: Quantcast Universal API
info.description: Quantcast GraphQL API access for organizations, accounts, campaigns, adsets, creatives, teams, surveys, geo resources, and reporting queries.

get.description: Retrieves an account metrics report from Quantcast.

parameters.name: connectionId
parameters.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

parameters.name: accountId
parameters.description: Quantcast account ID to report on.

schema.description: Quantcast account ID to report on.

parameters.name: startDate
parameters.description: Report start date in YYYY-MM-DD format.

schema.description: Report start date in YYYY-MM-DD format.

parameters.name: endDate
parameters.description: Report end date in YYYY-MM-DD format.

schema.description: Report end date in YYYY-MM-DD format.

parameters.name: timezone
parameters.description: Timezone used to interpret the report range.

schema.description: Timezone used to interpret the report range.

parameters.name: breakdowns
parameters.description: Quantcast breakdown display name, for example Day.

schema.description: Quantcast breakdown display name, for example Day.

parameters.name: metrics
parameters.description: Quantcast metric display name, for example Impressions.

schema.description: Quantcast metric display name, for example Impressions.

parameters.name: fields
parameters.description: Comma-separated response fields to include.

breakdowns.description: Breakdown values for the report row.

metadata.description: Additional metadata for the report row.

metrics.description: Metric values for the report row.

accountMetricsReport.description: Metrics report rows returned by Quantcast.

parameters.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

parameters.name: fields

downloadUrl.description: Signed download URL for the generated report.
